title: Exact Rejection Sampling for Non-Gaussian State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.21619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rejection sampling requires a proposal that dominates the target by a known constant, generally unavailable for non-Gaussian state space models. We construct such a proposal for the latent state path, yielding independent exact smoothing draws and an unbiased likelihood estimator whose relative variance is at most $1/p-1$ per draw at acceptance probability $p$. The method covers scalar states with affine Gaussian dynamics and log-concave observation densities, including multivariate observations. Transition twisting makes the log target-to-proposal ratio separable, and tangent-line twists make each term nonpositive, producing an attained, sharp dominating constant. With a companding node placement, the accumulated envelope error is $O(T/G^2)$ for a sample of length $T$ with $G$ nodes per date, so $G\propto\sqrt{T}$ keeps acceptance bounded away from zero; for stochastic volatility, the required conditions hold almost surely. tldr: 本文提出了一种针对非高斯状态空间模型的精确拒绝采样方法，通过构建已知支配常数的提议分布，实现了独立精确平滑抽样和无偏似然估计，并保证了误差可控和接受概率非零。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an exact rejection sampling method for non-Gaussian state space models, constructing a proposal with a known dominating constant to enable independent exact smoothing draws and unbiased likelihood estimation, with controlled error and non-zero acceptance probability.
